quest.title: The Shadow Over Petrichor
quest.description: You encounter a series of strange occurrences after arriving in Petrichor for the first time. You decide to get to the bottom of it all...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

dialogues.speaker: Leader
dialogues.text: Hey, you! Yes, you! You blithering idiot! What are you doing dragging your feet for? Waiting for us all to get old!? Why in the blazes aren't all these boxes already on the ship!?

dialogues.speaker: The Dude They Call "Idiot"
dialogues.text: No, Boss! It's just... These boxes are way too heavy! If we lug 'em all up, I think the ship might...

dialogues.speaker: Leader
dialogues.text: Might what? This is treasure here, treasure! You gonna just leave profit on the ground like that?

dialogues.speaker: The Dude They Call "Idiot"
dialogues.text: But... If we load everything on board, plus ourselves... I don't think the boat can hold all that weight!

dialogues.speaker: Leader
dialogues.text: Ha, that's an easy one! If we just leave a couple of you here on this island, we can bring all the treasure back, now can't we?

dialogues.speaker: The Dude They Call "Idiot"
dialogues.text: Ooh, a cunning plan, Boss! ... Wait, uh, I'm one of the ones you're taking with you, right? I don't wanna get captured by those golems, you've seen what happens to anyone they catch!

dialogues.speaker: Leader
dialogues.text: Then stop yapping and start moving! If the Dark Lord's lackeys catch up, we're all done for!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Dark Lord's lackeys? Are they putting on some kind of show?

dialogues.speaker: The Dude They Call "Idiot"
dialogues.text: Wait, Boss! There's people over there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, why don't we go ask them...

dialogues.speaker: Leader
dialogues.text: Oi, you! Yeah, you, the big 'un and the tiny thing! What're you skulking over there for?

choices.text: Uh oh, we're in trouble!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! We're not doing anything wrong over here, so what are you acting all nervous for?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, we should talk to them first.

response.speaker: Leader
response.text: Hmm, from the look of you, you must be foreigners. And here I thought you were minions of the Dark Lord Remus!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #This is {NICKNAME}, and Paimon's Paimon! And you're right, we're travelers! Oh, but who's this "Dark Lord Remus" you mentioned? Has he finished playing his part already?

response.speaker: Leader
response.text: Haha, you don't even know who the Dark Lord is!? ... Alright, I get it. I suppose it is up to me to educate you, O ignorant outlanders!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooooh!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Nice worldbuilding. Very detailed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And then? And then? What happened next? How did you defeat the Dark Lord?

response.speaker: Leader
response.text: The Dark Lord's golems are each mighty beyond measure. How could we be their match? Still, we had the aid of "Este the Quick-Witted" this time!

response.speaker: Leader
response.text: With his aid, we infiltrated the Dark Lord's fell keep, and reclaimed the treasures he and his minions plundered from us Fontainians!

response.speaker: The Dude They Call "Idiot"
response.text: Like the Boss said, uh... what is it we're doing again...? Oh yeah! "Disrupting the special military maneuvers being conducted by the Dark Lord's legions!" Totally a brilliant plan!

choices.text: You're the protagonists of your play, yet you aren't on the up and up...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, where's this Dark Lord? When does he take the stage?

response.speaker: Leader
response.text: Ha! Do you think we'd still be lugging treasure if he showed up? Hah! Like as not we'd all have been turned into golems already, just like Este probably was — "Este the Pitiful" now, more like!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! He totally helped you, and you guys just left him behind and ran away! Are you sure you guys aren't the baddies? Baddies don't get to be the protagonists!

response.speaker: Leader
response.text: Whaddaya mean, "protagonists," "take the stage"... Oi, from where I'm standing, it's looking like you're really his minions, just dressed up as foreigners — I can tell from all your blabbering on about performances and plays!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: EH? You mean, you guys aren't putting on a performance?

response.speaker: Leader
response.text: Hmph. So you won't 'fess up unless we char you first, eh? Let's get 'em, boys!

choices.text: When does this Dark Lord take the stage?
Can't leave any witnesses...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Huh? {NICKNAME}, what're you saying...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...There they go, huh? Guess they weren't acting after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But what was this "treasure" they were talking about? Dark Lord this, Dark Lord's keep that, no way any of that's real...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't we have a look at the "treasure"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh!? But we don't know where this stuff came from...

choices.text: Paimon, expressing disinterest in treasure!? Say it isn't so!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's just worried that... What if, well, just in case there's some kind of evil dark lord-y trap in it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, guess there's no dissuading you! But please be careful, okay?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph! Paimon knew they were just a bunch of frauds! There's no treasure at all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Or is this shabby excuse for a statue some kind of priceless artifact?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Let's go to Petrichor and ask around. Maybe it's some kind of landmark or lucky mascot or something!

response.speaker: Paimon's Voice
response.text: As for these "treasures"... We...

response.speaker: Paimon's Voice
response.text: #...Hey! {NICKNAME}, you...

choices.text: Consider this a necessary investigation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're not wrong, but... What if there's some kind of evil dark lord-y trap inside...

dialogues.text: Imperator. Imperator...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A... dream...?
You're finally awake, Imperator. This day is one of great import, the day when we shall sound the great Symphony, Phobos. There is yet time before the ritual, Imperator, but we should set out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I seem to have had a dream.
A dream, Imperator? I did not know that gods could dream... In that case, what did you dream of? The great plains beyond the north wind? The silver tree beneath the frozen soil...?
Or did you see that golden future that you once showed me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I saw... the sea swallowing the earth...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The children of white stone and brass sinking...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The collapse of all that was once radiant.
...That prophecy, then, Imperator? It is precisely to prevent it from happening, to fight against inevitable fate, that we are here today.
Just as you said, we have paid much for it, but once we are free of fa{RUBY#[D]Fortuna's}te's shackles, those sacrifices shall not have been in vain...
In this have I had faith ever since I accepted this body and became a Remurian...
...Apologies, Imperator. Forgive my lack of manners.
In any case, please, come with me.
Remus, Remus...
Remus. You once said that you would create a future free from the shackles of divine destiny.
Yet your realm now lies violently shattered, and the chasm you tried to bridge has grown deeper still. The immortal race you created and the peoples of the waters are slaughtering one another.
And now, this so-called Eternal City too faces imminent collapse...
You cannot control your own creation... The "Symphony" has brought neither justice nor happiness, but instead has become the source of all sin.
Though their flesh and blood have been sundered from water and soil, the lost souls guide them upon the path of inevitable death nonetheless. The curse of Fortuna is upon your people, and upon you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you still remember our promise...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That is our last resort... As long as the Symphony is played...
Is this the only way you usurper-lords of humanity know to atone after bringing things to ruination? Still, your resolve, at least, does not shame your kingly crown.
And a promise was made, indeed. Therefore, allow me to bear witness to your end...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #...{NICKNAME}... Please, wake up...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I... Just now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Waaah! You scared me to death! {NICKNAME}, you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You suddenly just... Completely stopped moving and started staring at the statue! Like you were a statue yourself! Paimon thought you had been turned to stone by the dark lord's evil curse...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think I had a strange daydream...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Th—There isn't really a curse, is there!? {NICKNAME}, are you okay!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm fine. Sorry for making you worry.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As long as you're not hurt... Yeah, we should definitely go to Petrichor first.

dialogues.speaker: "Bellringer"
dialogues.text: Welcome, travelers, O traversers of dreamscapes.

dialogues.speaker: "Bellringer"
dialogues.text: I am the bellringer at the intersection clock tower — the guide that welcomes travelers to the Eternal City.

choices.text: Oh joy, more worldbuilding, eh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (...Could he be part of the same troupe as those thieves from before?)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, leaving that aside for now, all the townspeople we ran into on the way over were acting really weird. Do you know what that's about?

response.speaker: "Bellringer"
response.text: Why, everyone has gone to Machimos already. I imagine that they now dwell under the protection of the Sebastos.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, so in addition to the "Dark Lord Remus," now we've got a "Sebastos"? This is getting more complicated by the minute!

response.speaker: "Bellringer"
response.text: "Dark Lord Remus"... It would appear that in your journey, you have crossed paths with those uncouth barbarians. That is indeed a blasphemous title with which they besmirch the Sebastos Remus, our mighty Imperator.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so they're both the same Remus! They are the same person after all.

response.speaker: "Bellringer"
response.text: But it is of no consequence! The Sebastos may not be defined by the narrow notions of the tribal mob. Those despicable insects may speak slander as they wish, but the wise, inspired by his noblest ideals, will yet come forth in their droves.

response.speaker: "Bellringer"
response.text: When the bell of eternity tolls, all that has ever come to pass shall be erased, and all will be reborn, regardless of who they are or where they are from! Be grateful, and rejoice! Praise be!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What should we do, {NICKNAME}? This person sure seems lucid, but the stuff he's spouting is all kinds of whack! Y'think we've got a sleepwalker here? Maybe he's dreaming?

response.speaker: "Bellringer"
response.text: Hmm? Do you name me a dreamer?

choices.text: The symptoms do match.

response.speaker: "Bellringer"
response.text: D—Dreaming...? I certainly...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! You... Uh oh, he's out cold...
Travelers from outside? Halt.
Excellent, you two look completely... Mentally sound.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Finally, a normal person! Seriously, what's going on in this town?
Before that, let's get this gentleman somewhere safe. Can't be leaving him lying here, can we? He'll catch a cold.

response.speaker: Este
response.text: Anyway, allow me to reintroduce myself. Call me Este. I'm a member of the town's Daydream Club — I'm the only member present right now, though.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon's Paimon, and {M#he}{F#she}'s {NICKNAME}. We're...

choices.text: Tourists visiting Petrichor.

response.speaker: Este
response.text: Heh. In that case, your timing could hardly be worse. I'm afraid our present state might disappoint you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait. You introduced yourself as "Este"... We've heard that name before!

choices.text: It was you who brought the bandits into the Dark Lord's castle, was it not?

response.speaker: Este
response.text: Huh? What? So... you've also...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, no, we're wide awake, trust us! We just don't get why everyone's saying all sorts of crazy things...

response.speaker: Este
response.text: Oh, it's them...

response.speaker: Este
response.text: *sigh* Where to begin? The legend of the Faded Castle has never been a secret. Adventurers just like them come by looking for it every once in a while.

response.speaker: Este
response.text: And whether it's because the impression the name "Golden Troupe" conjures up is nothing more than poetic imagery, or because the castle was built millennia ago, it's more likely than not that nothing of value remains there now.

response.speaker: Este
response.text: Ah, but would they ever listen? Of course not! No sooner had I brought them over to the ruins in the mountains than they began destroying statues and stuffing them into boxes like people possessed!

response.speaker: Este
response.text: I could not stop them alone, so I went back to town to get help. I never imagined I'd find nothing but dazed stares and mad ramblings all around. It was like everyone had fallen under some hypnotic spell...

response.speaker: Este
response.text: The Daydream Club has researched hypnosis before, but something like this is far, far beyond our capabilities. My hypothesis is that something abnormal has occurred within the ruins. According to the records...

response.speaker: Este
response.text: ...Hmm. Actually, why are we the only ones not affected? Interesting. Most interesting...

choices.text: Perhaps we can find a solution in the ruins.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why don't you wait here, Este? Leave the adventuring to us! If you come too, you might get turned into a golem!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aww, is that your cat, Este? It's so cute!

response.speaker: Este
response.text: No, though the fellow who studied hypnotism would say that they are creatures with keen senses...

response.speaker: Este
response.text: Hmm. How odd. That, err, collar? Pendant? I could swear I've seen that accessory before...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, it ran off...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, ignoring the cat question for now, we should still go to the ruins first and have a look! Say, Este, how can we get there?

response.speaker: Este
response.text: The ruins? The mountain behind the town. Just so happens to be the exact direction that the cat ran off in.

choices.text: Hehe, kitty cat, hehe~

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #...{NICKNAME}, are you sure you're okay?

response.speaker: Este
response.text: Things are pretty murky right now. Take extra care.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You too, alright? We'll be right back, don't you worry!

choices.text: Then it's time we set off.
Maybe we can find treasure in the ruins!
Ah, I see you escaped with your life! Fabulous!
Passing adventurers.

response.speaker: Este
response.text: Adventurers, you say... You're not here to look for that castle or whatever, are you?

choices.text: We're members of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol.

response.speaker: Este
response.text: Patrol members, huh... My apologies, then, but I fear that at the current juncture, we townsfolk might struggle to cooperate with whatever investigation you're conducting...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Hey, hey! Best not to impersonate officials, don'cha think?)

choices.text: Who knows? We could be the ones dreaming.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No way, that's impossible! Um... At least, we probably aren't...?

choices.text: So, valiant guardian, shall we find the Eternal City to our left or our right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, you're in character already!? Are you sure you're okay?

talks.objective: Explore the ruins in the mountain

dialogues.text: Not bad, not bad. Your valor would not know shame, even should it stand in the company of the Marechaussee Hunters of old.

choices.text: Whoa, it's a rare shiny cat!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...We've seen a whole lot of really strange things on our journey. Even so, a glowing, talking cat... Paimon supposes it still makes the "rare" list...

response.speaker: Glowing Cat
response.text: #...One such as I shall not dwell on being called a "strange thing." O chosen champions, {NICKNAME} and Paimon, the time has come for true heroes such as ye to step forth!

response.speaker: Glowing Cat
response.text: Come with me unto the ancient kingdom of the deep seas. We must still the chaotic "Symphony" if we are to save the lost souls.

choices.text: Err, is this also part of the worldbuilding too?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, could it be like... One of the Yae Publishing House's novels, the ones with the "He Was Our Companion in the Last Life, but Only He Inherited the Memories" kind of plot?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of... Just who are you?

response.speaker: Ouranides of Ouranopolis
response.text: Must I start from the beginning? ... Very well. "Ouranides of Ouranopolis" is my name, a spirit-keeper of the ancient realm.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, Ou—Oura... Ouwhatnides of the where now? Ugh, what a tongue-twister! Paimon's just gonna call you "Osse" for short. That's close enough, right? What do you think?

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: Meow, meow!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Meow, meow?

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: Hmm. It appears that I cannot command this body as I wish, to the extent that bestial behaviors may even overbear me from time to time... If, from the beginning, I could only have...

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: Ahem! As the two of you can see, the boundaries between past and present have begun to blur thanks to the influence of the chaotic "Symphony." It is for this reason that I too have awoken. For now, the affected area is yet small.

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: The inhabitants of Petrichor have had their souls taken away. They exist in that maddened, dream-like state because the "Symphony" has temporarily granted them identities and memories to fill the void left behind.

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: It is as if a vessel filled with pure water has had its contents replaced with wondrous wine. An apt description, considering that those are memories of ancient history gifted by the "Symphony."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Let Paimon think... So what you're saying is that the townspeople of Petrichor have had their souls stolen? And then their bodies have been possessed... Waaah, that sounds super scary!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You said that the affected area isn't very large yet...

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: Thank you so much. The road to the ancient realm lies beneath this spring you see before you. I have caused the seal on the hidden path to manifest.

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: Next, I shall activate the device that maintains the seal...

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: There we go. Now then, help me retrieve the harp's strings, and I shall thus be able to break the seal and open the way.

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: Now then, let us go unto the faded castellum of gold.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A faded golden cast... Hmm, Este mentioned something about the legend of the Faded Castle too, right? Aren't we talking about these ruins?

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: Nay, nay. These are but scraps on the surface. The true castle lies deeper underwater.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... You sure do know much more than the cats in town, huh, Osse?

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: You compare me to the cats in town? Such... Hmph. Follow closely and try not to get lost, then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, he just jumped down! Can cats swim?

choices.text: Oh, right! I'm the hero! Let the journey begin!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Seriously, {NICKNAME}, how can you fall for this stuff so easily? Very well then, O chosen hero, for the sake of Paimon's tummy-tum, stand tall and move with haste to buy her some Fonta!

choices.text: It's a talking animal!

talks.objective: Follow Osse into the deep spring
Go to the underwater Faded Castle
Go to the underwater Faded Castle

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, Paimon didn't think there'd be such a huge space down below. Guess you do know your stuff, Osse!

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: This is but the tip of the iceberg! Once, an entire nation and the land upon which it was built sank beneath the waves... and my mission is to prevent that which has sunk from resurfacing.

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: ...Or so I believe.

choices.text: Poof, and just like that, you suddenly seem a lot less reliable...

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: Well, what am I but a cat that knows an inkling more than those in town, hmm?

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: Hehe... Anyway, we are the sole arbiters of whether the souls of the townsfolk can safely return to their bodies or not, so eyes up, now.

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: The Faded Castle is just through that great gate. Let us continue onward.

choices.text: I really wish I had a reliable guide.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In that case, leave the guiding to Paimon! ...Well, that's what Paimon would like to say, anyway!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, Paimon bets a lot of people can live in a huge castle like this!

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: But of course! And not just people, either...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! There you go again, saying creepy stuff with a straight face!

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: Oh, fret not! Surely heroes such as yourselves would dispatch any hidden ghosts or phantoms without breaking a sweat?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And what is this? What an exquisite box! Seems like a music box of some kind! Still, it doesn't seem to fit in too well with its surroundings.

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: Good eye. That is indeed a music box, but just as I have knowledge beyond ordinary cats, this music box has functions beyond most others.

choices.text: What, can it speak too?

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: Hmm? That... did not cross my mind. Regrettably, it does not have such a function — for now, at least.

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: Anyway, even those who lack any musical knowledge can freely operate the power of the "Symphony" using this box. We will have use of it later, I am sure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Huh? But isn't it because this "Symphony" has gone all whacky that all the townsfolk turned into... whatever they are now? So what if {NICKNAME} presses the wrong button or something?

choices.text: The "Symphony" here may also become chaotic...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And become "the source of all sins"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Wait, what? What "sins"? You okay over there, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: Peace, now, you need not be so fretful. The "Symphony" was mighty, beautiful, and glorious once, an existence that shouldered golden ideals.

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: That it sows chaos upon the surface is a mere mishap of misalignment, the result of evildoers misusing great, glorious power.

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: #But were it {NICKNAME}, surely {M#he}{F#she} would wield its power correctly.

choices.text: That's quite a lot of trust you're putting in us.

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: It might be more accurate to say that I have no other option. I am a mere cat at present, after all. Should I wish to make use of the music box myself, it might prove somewhat difficult.

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: We have spoken this much. Now, to put things to the test. Remember the strings we got from the harp in the ruins? Those were, in truth, the "scores" on which the "Symphony" was recorded.

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: As long as you place the score into the music box, the box shall play its tune all on its own.

choices.text: I wouldn't be so sure if I were you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Now's not the time to be joking around. What if Osse takes you seriously, huh?

choices.text: What sort of clumsy clod do you take me for, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's just thinking about the worst-case scenario. Maybe Osse might jump out from a corner and scare you. One of these unmoving statues might start walking around! Or maybe traps might spring out from the ground and the walls...!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Any of those could happen, right?

choices.text: My my, I didn't think you would be so catty...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, Paimon was just joking before! She didn't think you'd take it seriously... Um, it's Paimon's fault, okay? Don't be mad...

response.speaker: Osse
response.text: Meow, meow?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seriously!? Now you pretend to be a cat?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, that's a pretty happy tune, Paimon's feeling all warm and fuzzy inside...

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: Hehe, it seems this box still functions. Well now, are we not safe?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, so you weren't even sure if it would work or not!?

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: Not completely. One cannot judge a box by its cover, do you not concur?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon gets the feeling that you're not talking about the box at all... But never mind that. What should we do now?

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: The chaotic "Symphony" must be here. If we can locate it, we can retrieve the souls that have been taken from the townsfolk.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then let's have a look around for starters.

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: A reasonable judgment. If memory serves, this castle has a great many strange rooms. Perhaps they are worth investigating first.

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: Also, the castle's central hall plays host to a mysterious stage. Though no more plays shall ever be performed there...

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: It was once an entrance to a place deeper underwater still, where the power of the "Symphony" yet lingers. We must go and check for any further anomalies there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Deeper still...?

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: Indeed. I wonder what awaits us there?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, now's not the time to leave us hanging, Osse! You're a surprisingly petty one, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: Still, before the riddle may be solved, we must first find the clues that await us in the castle. Come, let us away.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The thieves, who were beaten so badly they couldn't spare even a thought for the "treasures," fled on their boat.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: And as it so happens, there were no traps in the container, of the evil dark lord-y variety or otherwise.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: But there was no valuable treasure within either. Within was naught but heavy shards of shattered stone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, this should be Petrichor!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's even more beautiful than we'd heard.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, and the sea breeze is super comfy, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, is it just Paimon, or is this place kinda deserted...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eek!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did something happen?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, um, nothing! Let's just, uh, go somewhere else first, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Imperator...
